findings.finding: The moving symbol `_update_one_dispatch_links` (defined at `dispatch_one.py:702`, inside the 432-796 sub-tree the plan relocates to `dispatch_update.py`) is a keyed entry in `.github/complexity-baseline.json:30` as `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/dispatch_one.py::_update_one_dispatch_links`. The plan's Scope inventory omits `.github/complexity-baseline.json`.
findings.location: Scope section (four-file list) and 'Extract the entire update_one sub-tree — lines 432-796'
scenarios: `.github/complexity-baseline.json:30` retains the stale `dispatch_one.py::_update_one_dispatch_links` key while the C901 scan now reports `dispatch_update.py::_update_one_dispatch_links`; `scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py` `_run_check` returns 1 (new entry = regression), failing `make lint`/CI even though behaviour is unchanged.

findings.suggested_fix: Run the C901 baseline updater after the move (or manually rename the key at .github/complexity-baseline.json:30 from `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/dispatch_one.py::_update_one_dispatch_links` to `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/dispatch_update.py::_update_one_dispatch_links`, preserving the ceiling value 17 and sorted ordering), and add the file to Scope and an acceptance criterion.
